method: Visual inspection by the authoring assistant of all 33 rendered pages in six contact sheets, followed by higher-resolution inspection of the new implication examples, polynomial benchmark qualifications, workspace comparison table, and negative-test discussion. Title, contents, mathematical displays, table continuations, section breaks, appendices, and references were inspected.
findings: No clipping, overlapping text, missing mathematical glyphs, or nearly blank spillover pages found.
The mathematical corrections and added comparison table remain legible within page margins.
Questions and appendices begin on deliberate pages; references fit together.
Intentional whitespace remains around unsplit tables and separate appendices.
limitation: Visual layout review only; not mathematical proof or accessibility certification.
